title: PETABLOCKS: Darklands
description: A unique, atmospheric survival experience locked in perpetual midnight.
body: A unique, atmospheric survival experience locked in perpetual midnight. Stranded on a massive, custom single-biome map where the sun never rises, players must adapt to a world of endless shadow. With resources constrained by a singular landscape and danger lurking in the permanent dark, survival requires ingenuity, automation, and absolute vigilance. Step into the gloom, conquer the elements, and see if you can thrive where daylight is just a myth.
